tools.name: lookup_fact
tools.description: Search the library of facts. Each line leads with the sentence label: PROVEN covers the exact statement a machine checked, REASONED a real-world claim whose arithmetic a machine checked, and every match says what is not proven. Compact by default (claim start, label, receipt link); set detail true f

tools.name: check_claim
tools.description: Find the claims in a text and check the ones plain code can: arithmetic, primes, unit conversions. Each claim is shown as PROVEN with holds true or false when a machine settled it, or GUESS, not checked, which never means false, with a next step. Its label field is the engine's word: PROVEN, FALSIFI

tools.name: search_attempts
tools.description: Search the list of past attempts at P vs NP. Rows are labeled REASONED (a named source says where it broke) or GUESS: graded educated (a likely break step, no source read for it) or not weighed (open for anyone to trace). A match is a warning sign, never a verdict.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "search_attempts" stacks urgency/override words (never, warning). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
